title: Nourishing Catalan Kabocha Wrap
description: A fresh, springy vegetarian wrap inspired by Catalan flavors, featuring sweet kabocha squash and savory fillings wrapped in a corn husk for a healthy meal prep option.
instructions: Rinse the corn husks and soak them in warm water for 10 minutes to soften.
Slice the kabocha squash into 1/2 inch thick rounds and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the kabocha slices for 4 minutes on each side until lightly caramelized.
In the same skillet, add black beans, cumin, smoked paprika, salt and pepper, and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the cooked quinoa and let the mixture heat through, then remove from heat.
Drain the soaked corn husks and pat them dry with a towel.
Place a spoonful of the quinoa and bean mixture onto the center of each husk, top with a slice of sautéed kabocha and crumble feta cheese.
Fold the husk edges over the filling, then roll tightly to form a wrap.
Wrap each corn husk roll in foil and bake at 180°C for 10 minutes to warm the filling.
Remove from oven, let cool slightly, then cut into bite‑sized pieces and serve or refrigerate for meal‑prep.
